polls.caveat: ~500-person metro subsample (±4.4%); single house; its likely-voter screen filters out low-propensity, disproportionately ANC-leaning voters. ANC 18 sits below even the DA's own internal polling.

polls.caveat: ~503-person metro subsample; same house and turnout model as the July wave.
polls.label: SRF · Johannesburg · Feb–Mar 2026

polls.caveat: ⛔ THE DA FIGURE IS DISPUTED BETWEEN OUTLETS: Daily Maverick and allAfrica report DA 27, Bloomberg reports DA 28 from the same release; 28 is used here because it is the figure the fuller party breakdown came with. NO SOURCE IN THE CHAIN REACHED IPSOS'S OWN RELEASE — the ANC/DA line comes from secondary reporting (newsroom/2026-09-05.md), the ActionSA/EFF/MK split from Fullview citing the same release (newsroom/2026-09-13.md). The CoJ subsample size and the fieldwork window are unverified. First non-SRF, non-party-internal CoJ read since March, and it swings sharply toward the ANC against every other 2026 CoJ number on file. Admitted to the register on the owner's instruction 2026-09-27 ('add all new polls found'); admission to the REGISTER is not admission to the FORECAST, which is gated by poll_paths and is off.
polls.fieldwork: reported 4 September 2026; fieldwork window not stated in any source reached
polls.label: Ipsos Khayabus · Johannesburg · September 2026
